oneOf.description:
The club whose data it was rendered with; `null` for a typed-in
address without a club.

to.description: Everyone it's addressed to, in one mail.

ids.description: All sponsors' ids in the new order.

new_rider_id.description: The rider taking their place, of the same club.

partner_name.description: The partner the club enters, if it knows them.

oneOf.description:
The waiting rider of the club the request was matched with, now the
partner of a pair act.

id.description: The id of the unmapped registration.

oneOf.description:
The jury unit to register the judge for instead; `None` drops the
registration.

ResolvedFeatures.description: Whether each feature is on, after [`Features::resolve`].

force.description: Confirms applying the pending migrations of an older backup.

missing_songs.description: Acts whose song file isn't in the data directory.

snapshot_filename.description: The backup of the state before the restore; restoring it undoes this.

Rider.description: A rider with their club and starts.

age_on_competition.description: On the determining day; only for who may see birthdates.

birthdate.description: Only for who may see birthdates.

checked_in_at.description: When the rider checked in on competition day.

fee_waived.description: The rider's own starts are all free (a rider's fee waiver).

fee_waiver.description: Why the rider's fees are waived.

group_count.description: Number of groups the rider is in, as a regular or replacement rider.

waived_count.description: Starts in acts whose fee is waived. They cost nothing.

Role.description: What a user may do on the organizer side.

SentClubMail.description: A club mail in the log: as written, with every mail as it went out.

SentMail.description: One mail of a club mail as it went out.

oneOf.description: The club whose data it was rendered with, and its name at the time.

slots.description:
The complete order of the block. Its started and ended slots must
come first, as they are.

checked_in_at.description:
The check-in time set for riders that weren't checked in yet. Riders
that already were keep their earlier time. `null` when checking out.

members.description:
All riders of this club in the group. Riders of other clubs are kept.
An empty list means the club leaves the group.

warning.description:
Set if a rider of the group is now also in another group of the same
type. The change is saved anyway, but the group has no category until
the clubs sort it out. A German message for the user.

Set if a rider of the group is now also in another group of the new
type. The change is saved anyway, but the groups have no category until
the clubs sort it out. A German message for the user.

name.description: Empty or missing (together with `email`) means the club's owner.

oneOf.description: The act's start, for every rider.
All the club's fees: start fees and jury fee.

reason.description:
Why the fees are waived, e.g. "Veranstalter"; `null` charges them
again.

oneOf.description: All the rider's starts.

slots.description: The slots to change; the others keep their acts.

skip.description: Skip its Vorlauf (its acts start directly in its final) or run it.

url.description: a URL the server downloads the image from.

images.description: The images after the change, with the result of a download.

deployments.description:
The deployments to credit the club with; null to use the registered
ones again.

single.description: Whether the rider rides a single.

roles.description: Every role the user holds afterwards.

SlotGroupInfo.description: A run of slots as the admin API returns it.

SlotGroupInput.description: A run of slots as the admin API takes it: the heat by id.

heat_id.description: The heat whose best acts fill these slots.

Song.description: A song as the players load it.

file.description: The file in the data directory.

original.description: The original upload instead of the normalized copy.

url.description: Where web players load it from, e.g. `/songs/<file>`.

version.description:
The image is at `/api/competition/sponsors/{id}/image?v={version}`;
the version changes with the image.

SponsorImageUpload.description: The multipart body: the sponsor's id, then the image as the file.

StartlistAct.description: An act on the public startlist.

StartlistActParticipant.description: A participant of a startlist act: no ages, no club ids.

Structure.description:
The competition's structure: its disciplines in act type order (single
female, single male, pair, small group, large group).

oneOf.description: The current competition; `None` until one is configured.

jury_registration.description:
Whether the jury registration is on (the competition's feature, else
the build default); everything about judges is hidden without it.

moderation_input.description: Whether the act description field is enabled for the current competition.

startlist_published.description:
Whether an admin published the start list and the timeplan; before,
only the organizer team sees them.

category_id.description: The act's own category; in a mixed block it differs from the block's.

music_started_at.description:
When the act's music first started while it ran; the act timer counts
from here.

TimeplanBreak.description:
A break inside a start block, e.g. an extra warm-up. It runs until
"Weiter" ends it; `duration_seconds` is only its plan.

oneOf.description:
A start block: acts (of any category) and breaks, or a final's
reserved slots.

Acts.description:
A start block: acts (of any category) and breaks, or a final's
reserved slots.

categories.description: The categories of the block's acts, in order of appearance.

description.description:
What to show: the label, otherwise the home category's (or
final's) description.

einfahrzeit_seconds.description: The configured warm-up: the block's own or the home category's.

oneOf.description:
The final running here instead of a category (by id and name);
its slots are `Finalist` slots.
The category whose acts run here by default, by id and name.

label.description: The block's own name, e.g. "Nachstarter"; usually none.

manually_ordered.description: The order was edited by hand (`set_block_order`).

preliminary_skipped.description:
A block of a category whose heat's Vorlauf is skipped ("Vorlauf
entfällt"): its acts start directly in the final, so it runs none
of them and takes no time.

warmup_seconds.description:
The warm-up this block really gets: none for an empty block, and a
block sharing the warm-up of an empty category before it gets
that one (see `crate::timeplan::effective_warmups`).

internal.description: Only the organizer team sees it (Interner Zeitplaneintrag).

show_photos.description: Photos next to the clock on the info board.

TimeplanFinalist.description:
A reserved slot of a final, e.g. "3. Finalist (E EM 1)": it runs and is
judged like an act. Planned before the finalists are known; once the
final's placement is published, `act` is the act placed in it.

oneOf.description: The act placed in the slot, once the placement is published.

group_label.description: The name of the heat the finalist comes from, e.g. "E EM 1".

heat_id.description: The heat the finalist comes from, by id.

music_started_at.description:
When the placed act's music first started while the slot ran; the
timer counts from here.

TimeplanFinalistAct.description: The act placed in a final's slot. Its song plays in the slot.

category_id.description: The act's category, from its heat.

TimeplanListEntry.description:
The label an internal timeplan entry has for the public.
A timeplan entry as the list shows it, without its content.

oneOf.description: Start blocks only: the home category, by id and name.

einfahrzeit_seconds.description:
Start blocks only: overrides the home category's (or final's)
Einfahrzeit.

oneOf.description:
Start blocks only: the final running here instead of a category, by
id and name.

internal.description:
Custom entries: an internal timeplan entry. Only the organizer team
gets it as it is; everyone else gets a "Pause" of the same length.

manually_ordered.description:
Start blocks only: the order was edited by hand (`set_block_order`),
so the category's start order no longer applies to it.

show_photos.description: Custom entries: photos next to the clock on the info board.

oneOf.description: Whether this player is the one that plays.

Load the song, ready to start; stops what is playing. Also sent again
after a reconnect: a player that still plays this song keeps playing.
Unload the song.
Songs coming up, to load in advance.

UnmappedRegistration.description:
A registration of a migrated jury category that matched no heat or final
(JURY-5), for the jury lead to move to one. It counts for nothing meanwhile.

old_unit.description: The name of the old jury category.

User.description: A user as the organizers see them.

VariableInfo.description: A variable the sender may use, for the mail form.

WaiverClub.description: A club a waiver concerns, by its name at the time.

post.summary:
Add a new category, defined by its age class: the birthday bounds follow
from the determining day.

Register a judge of a club, with the jury units (heats' Vorlaufs and finals) and tasks they can
do. Clubs can until the judge deadline, admins always.

post.description: It isn't planned yet; add a timeplan entry with its `final_id` for that.
post.summary: Add a final: reserved slots for the best riders of the heats.

Add a heat: a group of categories of one discipline whose best acts fill
a final's slots.

post.description: Only the club (or an admin) can add riders to it.
post.summary:
Add a rider to a club, without starts; those are set with the start
commands (`set_single`, `request_pair`, `link_pair`, `leave_pair`).

post.description: A sponsor without an image isn't shown (#291). Admin.
post.summary: Add a sponsor at the end of the info board's footer.

post.description:
This endpoint is used to create a new timeplan entry: a start block or a
custom entry (a break, an award ceremony, …).
post.summary: Add a new timeplan entry.

Applies a remap file of judge registrations a replace dropped (ADR
0005): every entry with a filled-in, existing `jury_unit` (`heat: <name>`
or `final: <name>`) registers its judge for that jury unit and task
again. Entries whose judge or jury unit isn't found, or whose jury unit
takes no registrations (D6), are listed back. Jury lead.

Assign a judge a task in a jury unit of the Juryplan. Untrained
people only count dismounts; one task per judge and unit. Jury lead.

post.description:
Clears the song fields and `song_checked`, so the act counts as having no
song and the usual flows ask for a new upload. Files on disk are left
alone. Admins only; meant for songs that `list_missing_songs` reports and
that can't be uploaded again.
post.summary: Mark an act's song as permanently deleted.

Record a booking: a payment of a club (a refund when negative), an
unassigned or an ignored booking. Treasurer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: CreateClub a new user.

post.description:
The club becomes the group's owner and chooses its type. The group starts
without riders; add them with `set_club_group_members`. Group names are
unique across the competition (case-insensitive).
post.summary: Create a group act.

Creates the competition from scratch in setup mode (ADR 0005, ADR 0011),
as an alternative to importing a file: only what the competition needs to
exist. The determining day is 1 June of the start year; categories,
timeplan, branding and the rest are added in the competition editor.
Refused while a competition exists (ADR 0001). Admin.

post.description: Admins only. Fails with a conflict if a backup of the same second exists.
post.summary:
Back up the database now: a `VACUUM INTO` snapshot next to the database
file, named like the backups before migrations.

Delete a booking, e.g. one recorded twice; the payment log keeps it.
Treasurer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to delete an existing category.
post.summary: Delete a category.

post.description:
Only the group's owner club (or an admin) can delete it. The owner club
can't delete a group while riders of other clubs are still in it.
post.summary: Delete a group. Its riders stay registered.
Remove a judge with their registrations.

post.description:
Admins only. Every name must be an existing backup; if one isn't, nothing
is deleted (404). The live database can never be deleted this way.
post.summary: Delete database backups.

post.description: Not possible once the final has started.
post.summary: Delete a final, with its slots and its timeplan block.

post.description: Not possible while a final's slots are filled from it.
post.summary: Delete a heat; its categories belong to no heat afterwards.

post.description:
Only the rider's club (or an admin) can delete them. Their single and
pair acts are deleted too; the partner is left with a pair request. Groups
keep their other riders.
post.summary: Delete a rider.

post.description:
This endpoint is used to delete an existing timeplan entry. The acts of a
start block go back to their home blocks; it is refused if one of those
has ended already.
post.summary: Delete a timeplan entry.

post.description: Only the club of one of its riders (or an admin) can do it.
post.summary:
Dissolves a pair act: both riders leave the pair competition, nobody is
left waiting for a partner. To keep the partner waiting, use `leave_pair`.

Change a booking: its amount, date or note, or assign it to a club,
unassign or ignore it. Treasurer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to update a category's properties.
post.summary: Edit an existing category.

post.description:
Only clubs with a rider in the act, the club that created a group, and
admins can edit it.
post.summary: Edit an act's title and description.
Change a judge and replace their registrations. The club stays the same.

Changes the competition's settings, also while the registration is open
(ADR 0005). Validated like the competition file; applies right away. The
categories' birthday bounds follow the determining day, as they're derived
from it. Admin.

post.description:
Every field is overwritten. Its slots are only created anew when the slot
groups change, which isn't possible once the final has started; a slot
with the same heat and number keeps its placed act. Every heat shares the
final's discipline.
post.summary: Edit a final.

post.description:
A rename is only a new name: everything that refers to the heat does so
by its id. The categories keep the
discipline of the finals the heat fills. Acts already placed in a final
stay when their category leaves the heat.
post.summary: Edit a heat: its name, description, categories and threshold.

Change the jury settings of a heat's Vorlauf or of a final: whether judges
can register for it, its deployments and the judges it needs per task.
Changing its deployments changes every club's registered deployments.
Jury lead.

post.description: Only the rider's club (or an admin) can edit them.
post.summary:
Edit a rider's own data; their starts are changed with the start
commands.

post.description:
This endpoint is used to update a timeplan entry's properties. Every field
is overwritten.
post.summary: Edit an existing timeplan entry.

Imports a competition file: creates the competition in setup mode, or
replaces it as `--replace-competition` does, keeping its id and the club
data (ADR 0005). An invalid file changes nothing. The new settings apply
right away, without a restart. Admin.

post.description: Only the rider's club (or an admin) can do it.
post.summary:
Takes a rider out of the pair competition: their pair request goes, or
their pair act is dissolved and the partner is left waiting for a new
partner (a pair request without a name).

post.description:
Clubs link riders of their own club, the organizer also riders of
different clubs. Fails if one of them already rides a pair.
post.summary: Links two riders to a pair act; their pair requests are fulfilled.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: Login a new user.
Log out the currently authenticated user.

post.description: This endpoint is used to reorder categories.
post.summary: Move a category down by swapping order with the next category.

post.description: This endpoint is used to reorder categories.
post.summary: Move a category up by swapping order with the previous category.

Move all registrations of a judge for one jury unit to another, e.g.
from a skipped Vorlauf. A registration the judge already has there
merges (at most one per judge, task and unit). Jury lead.

post.description: This endpoint is used to reorder timeplan entries.
post.summary: Move a timeplan entry down by swapping places with the next entry.

post.description: This endpoint is used to reorder timeplan entries.
post.summary: Move a timeplan entry up by swapping places with the previous entry.

Renders a club mail (Rundmail) as `send_club_mail` would send it, without
sending or keeping anything. Admin, jury lead and treasurer.

What importing a competition file would replace and drop, without
changing anything; invalid files fail as the import would. Admin.

post.description:
A failed download keeps the last good copy and is reported in the
response and in the competition management (#291). Takes as long as the
slowest download, up to 30 seconds. Admin.
post.summary: Download all URL images again ("Bilder aktualisieren").

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: Register a new user.

post.description: Needs a login and the permission to manage users or the reload token.
post.summary: Reload the database from disk, e.g. after `seed_demo` replaced it.

post.description: The competition's logo applies again (#291). Admin.
post.summary: Remove the info board's break image.

post.description: The logo built into the binary applies again (#286); a URL source goes too. Admin.
post.summary: Remove the competition's logo.
Remove a sponsor and its image (#291). Admin.

post.description: This endpoint is used to rename a club.
post.summary: Rename a club.

post.description: Only the group's owner club (or an admin) can rename it.
post.summary: Rename a group.

post.description: `ids` must be all sponsors, each once (#291). Admin.
post.summary: Set the order of the sponsors in the info board's footer.

post.description:
For a single, the new rider gets the single (by their gender, which must
be known) and the old one loses it. For a pair, the new rider becomes the
partner of the remaining rider (and their pair request is fulfilled). The
new rider must be of the same club (admins: any club) and not already ride
a single or pair. Group riders
are set with `set_club_group_members`.
post.summary:
Replace a rider of a single or pair, keeping the act with its title,
description and music.

post.description:
Fails if the rider already rides a pair. Only the rider's club (or an
admin) can ask.
post.summary:
The rider waits for a pair partner (a pair request, Paaranfrage), named
or not; it replaces an earlier request. A waiting rider of the club with
that name, who names this rider or nobody, becomes the partner at once.
Partners of other clubs are linked by the organizer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: RequestPasswordReset a new user.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: ResendMailValidation a new user.

post.description:
Deletes the block's stored order and its breaks. Acts that came from
other blocks go back to their home blocks, unless one of those has ended;
acts of its category that sit in other blocks stay there. A final's block
gets its slots' order back, followed by the acts of its skipped heats.
Blocks that have started keep their order.
post.summary: Puts a start block back to category order.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: PasswordReset a new user.

Resolve a registration the migration to jury units could not map (JURY-5):
register the judge for a heat's Vorlauf or a final, or drop it. Jury lead.

post.description:
Admins only (the reload token doesn't count). Checks the backup again:
a corrupt backup, one without an Admin user and one from a newer release
are always refused (409); one with an older schema needs `force` (409
listing the migrations). Refused while music plays. The current state is
backed up first; if anything fails after the swap began, it is put back.
Missing songs don't block, they are listed in the response.
post.summary: Restore the database from a backup.

post.description:
Replaces an earlier upload, which also resets `song_checked`: the new file
hasn't been checked yet. Only clubs with a rider in the act, the club that
created a group, and admins can upload; clubs only until the music
deadline. Only mp3 files up to 10 MiB are accepted. A loudness-normalized
copy is made in the background (see `normalize`).
post.summary: Upload an act's song.

Send a club mail (Rundmail): one mail per club, rendered with its data,
to its club contact and club representative, and one per typed-in
address. Every mail is rendered before the first one goes out; one that
fails doesn't stop the others. Returns the mail as the log keeps it.
Admin, jury lead and treasurer.

Reports that the music of a running act just started in the music
control's own browser; remote players report it themselves. Only the first
start counts, and acts that don't run are left alone.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: EditClubAct a new user.

post.description:
A withdrawn act doesn't start: it leaves the startlist and the
timeplan and shows no category. Its riders still pay for it unless the fee
is waived (`set_fee_waived`; the announcement refunds only with a medical
certificate); withdrawing doesn't change a waiver.
Before the deadline, clubs simply delete their riders instead.
post.summary: Withdraws an act after the registration deadline, or takes it back.

post.description:
Acts from other blocks leave them. Acts of this block that the list leaves
out go back to their home block (the first block of their category), to
its end; breaks it leaves out are deleted. Only slots that haven't started
can be moved, also in the running block. Ended blocks can't be changed.

A final's block orders its finalist slots and the acts of its skipped
heats the same way; it takes no other acts, and they go to no other
block. Slots and acts it leaves out follow at its end.
post.summary:
Sets the order of a start block: which acts (of any category) and breaks
run in it, and in which order.

post.description:
Shown while no act runs. Replaces an earlier break image or URL source
(#291). Checked and scaled like the logo. Without one, the competition's
logo applies. Admin.
post.summary: Upload the info board's break image.

post.description:
Check-in and music control. Works after registration closed. Fails as a
whole if one of the riders doesn't exist.
post.summary: Check riders in (or out) on competition day.

post.description:
Every club can join every group, but only with its own riders. The group's
type stays as its owner chose it, whatever the number of riders. If a rider
of the group (from any club) is then in two groups of the same type, the
change is saved with a warning and both groups lose their category until
that's sorted out, since clubs add their riders to a shared group one after
another.
post.summary: Set a club's riders in a group.

post.description:
Only the group's owner club (or an admin) can change it. The group then
belongs to the other type's categories.
post.summary: Change a group's type (Kleingruppe or Großgruppe).

post.description:
Without a name and email the club's owner is responsible. Clubs can change
it while registration is open, admins always.
post.summary: Set the club's Vereinsverantwortliche/r, who files objections at the event.

post.description:
Replaces an earlier logo or URL source (#286). The format comes from the
content: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, of any size. Raster images are scaled
down to 3840 px (4K) on the long edge if larger and lose their metadata;
SVG images are stored as they are, but refused if they could run scripts
or load other files (see `crate::logo`). Admin.
post.summary: Upload the competition's logo.

Waive the fees of a club, a rider or an act in full, or charge them
again. Treasurer.

post.description:
A slot takes the acts of its heat's categories, each at most once per
final.
A slot that has started keeps its act. Once the placement is published,
changes show in the timeplan right away.
post.summary: Place acts in the slots of a final.

post.description:
Once published, the timeplan shows the placed acts in the final's slots
and the player plays their songs. It can't be withdrawn once the final
has started.
post.summary: Publish (or withdraw) the placement of a final.

post.description:
While skipped, its categories' blocks stay in the timeplan but run none
of its acts; they start in the final that its slots belong to, if that is
planned. Once an act of the heat or its final has started, it can't
change.
post.summary:
Skip a heat's Vorlauf or run it again (Konzept §1.5). The tool suggests
skipping when the heat has fewer acts than its threshold; the organizer
decides here.

post.description:
An SVG gets the checks of an upload. A URL is downloaded at once and again
at every start and by the refresh; the server serves the local copy and
never hands the URL to a browser (#291). A failed download isn't an error:
it shows in the response and the image keeps its last good copy. Admin.
post.summary:
Set the source of the logo, the break image or a sponsor's logo to an
inline SVG or a URL.

Credit a club with jury deployments instead of the registered ones, e.g.
after a late cancellation or as a waiver. Jury lead.

Publish the Juryplan to the clubs, or take it back. Each club then sees
its own judges' assignments. Publishing waits for the end of the judge
registration, so clubs can't change their judges under the plan. Admin
only.

Hides a photo from the info board (e.g. a blurry one), so the next newest
shows instead, or shows it again. Kept until the server restarts.

post.description: Only the rider's club (or an admin) can change it.
post.summary:
Add or remove a rider's single, Einzel weiblich or männlich by their
gender (which a new single needs).

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: EditClubAct a new user.

Approve the start list and the timeplan of the current competition for
the public, or take the approval back. Until then only the organizer
team sees them; afterwards changes show right away. Admin only.

post.description:
Admin only. Admins can't drop their own Admin role, so there's always
one left.
post.summary: Grant a user exactly these roles.

post.description:
Undoing the start of an entry also undoes the skips of the empty start
blocks right before it, since they were skipped in the same step. Undoing
the start of a slot that followed a break reopens the break, since ending
it started the slot.
post.summary: Moves the live timeplan one step back, undoing the last forward step.

post.description:
Ends the running act or break, starts the next slot of the running block,
or ends the running entry and starts the next one. Ending a break starts
the next slot in the same step; ending the last slot ends the block. Empty
start blocks are skipped on the way. Ending an act stops the music on the
active player.
post.summary: Moves the live timeplan one step forward.
Remove a judge from a jury unit of the Juryplan. Jury lead.
Change a sponsor's name and link (#291). Admin.

post.description:
Replaces an earlier image or URL source (#291). Checked and scaled like
the logo. The text field `id` comes before the file. Admin.
post.summary: Upload a sponsor's logo.

post.description: This endpoint is used to create a new user.
post.summary: VerifyMail a new user.

get.summary:
Check a backup before restoring it: blocking problems, pending
migrations and missing songs. The backup is opened read-only.

The competition as a competition file to download, without club data
(see `crate::export`); the import and `--competition` take it unchanged.
It contains the photo password, and the logo if it's an SVG. Admin.
Get information about an act.

Get information about a club. The owner's and the Vereinsverantwortliche's
name and email address are only included for the club itself and the organizer.

What the club mail form needs: every club with its contacts and what the
recipient presets look at, and the variables the sender may use. Money
only with club balances, the jury obligation only with the jury or club
balances.

The competition's images and where they come from, with the failed
downloads to warn about (#291). Admin.
The competition's settings to edit, with the photo password. Admin.

The info board's photos: the newest one and how many there are. Public,
like the info board.

What plays now: the song on the active player, or in the music control's
own browser, with its act and position. Public, like the moderation
screen that shows it.

The startlist as CSV, one section per timeplan entry. Breaks inside a
start block and the reserved slots of a final get their own `#` line.
Before the publication only the organizer team gets it.

get.description:
A final appears once, with all the heats that feed it. Heats no final
takes from are in `heats_without_final` of their discipline. Every
category belongs to a heat in a finished plan; the others are in
`without_heat`. Acts without a category (incomplete
groups) are in `without_category`. Withdrawn acts stay in their category,
marked. Heats without categories
